query.name: com.psugasia.ptc5.guardian.open
query.sql:
select ps.id, ps.name, ps.instructions, ps.priority_limit, ps.general_limit, case when cast(systimestamp at time zone (select timezone_code from u_ptc5_settings where rownum = 1) as date) between to_date(ps.priority_open,'YYYY-MM-DD"T"HH24'||chr(58)||'MI') and to_date(ps.priority_close,'YYYY-MM-DD"T"HH24'||chr(58)||'MI') then 1 else 0 end ispriority, ps.termdcids, ps.checkteacherschedule, ps.siblingtimeslots, ( select message
from u_students_ptc5
where studentsdcid = :c ) as studentmessage
from u_ptc5_sessions ps
where nvl(ps.status,0) = 1 and ps.schoolid = :a and ps.yearid = :b and (:d <> 'student' or (:d = 'student' and nvl(ps.studentsignup,0) = 1)) and ps.grade_levels like '%,'||(select grade_level from students where dcid = :c)||',%' and nvl((select excluded from u_students_ptc5 where studentsdcid = :c),0) = 0 and ( ( (select nvl(priorityonly,0) from u_students_ptc5 where studentsdcid = :c) = 1 and cast(systimestamp at time zone (select timezone_code from u_ptc5_settings where rownum = 1) as date) between to_date(ps.priority_open,'YYYY-MM-DD"T"HH24'||chr(58)||'MI') and to_date(ps.priority_close,'YYYY-MM-DD"T"HH24'||chr(58)||'MI') ) or cast(systimestamp at time zone (select timezone_code from u_ptc5_settings where rownum = 1) as date) between to_date(ps.general_open,'YYYY-MM-DD"T"HH24'||chr(58)||'MI') and to_date(ps.general_close,'YYYY-MM-DD"T"HH24'||chr(58)||'MI') or exists ( select tc.personid from u_ptc5_testingcontacts tc inner join guardianpersonassoc gpa on tc.personid = gpa.personid where gpa.guardianid = :p ) )
order by ps.name

query.name: com.psugasia.ptc5.guardian.section.timeslots
query.sql:
with sectionptcteacheroverride as ( select distinct e.dcid, pc.schoolstaffdcid
from u_ptc5_cc pc inner join cc d on pc.ccid = d.id inner join sections e on d.sectionid = e.id inner join students s on d.studentid = s.id
where pc.u_ptc5_sessionsid = :f and s.dcid = :c and e.dcid = :h ), sectionptcteacher as ( select e.dcid as sectiondcid, t.dcid as schoolstaffdcid
from sections e inner join teachers t on e.teacher = t.id
where e.dcid = :h and e.dcid not in (select distinct dcid from (select * from sectionptcteacheroverride) where dcid is not null) )
select pt.id, pt.startdt, pt.enddt, pt.capacity
from u_ptc5_timeslots pt left outer join u_ptc5_timeslots_courses ptc on pt.id = ptc.u_ptc5_timeslotsid left outer join u_ptc5_timeslots_sections pte on pt.id = pte.u_ptc5_timeslotsid left outer join u_ptc5_timeslots_schoolstaff ptss on pt.id = ptss.u_ptc5_timeslotsid
where pt.u_ptc5_sessionsid = :f and (ptc.coursedcid is null or ptc.coursedcid = (select c2.dcid from sections e2 inner join courses c2 on e2.course_number = c2.course_number where e2.dcid = :h)) and (pte.sectiondcid is null or pte.sectiondcid = (select e2.dcid from sections e2 where e2.dcid = :h)) and (ptss.schoolstaffdcid is null or ptss.schoolstaffdcid = (select schoolstaffdcid from (select * from sectionptcteacher))) and nvl(pt.admin,0) = 0 and nvl(pt.status,0) = 1 and pt.grade_levels like '%,'||(select grade_level from students where dcid = :c)||',%' and (:g = '1' or (:g = '0' and nvl(pt.priorityonly,0) = 0)) and (:k = '1' or (:k = '0' and nvl(pt.mustmeet,0) = 0)) and pt.id not in ( select u_ptc5_timeslotsid from u_ptc5_timeslots_blocked where schoolstaffdcid = :i and status = 1 )
order by pt.startdt, pt.enddt
